examples.ar: مِّنَ الْمُؤْمِنِينَ رِجَالٌ صَدَقُوا مَا عَاهَدُوا اللَّهَ عَلَيْهِ.
examples.en: Among the believers are men who have been true to their covenant with God.
And We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds.

examples.ar: وَيَسْأَلُونَكَ عَنِ الرُّوحِ ۖ قُلِ الرُّوحُ مِنْ أَمْرِ رَبِّي.
examples.en: And they ask you about the soul. Say, 'The soul is of the affair of my Lord.'

examples.ar: إِنَّ اللَّهَ هُوَ الرَّزَّاقُ ذُو الْقُوَّةِ الْمَتِينُ.
examples.en: Indeed, God is the Provider, the possessor of power, the Mighty.

examples.ar: رَأْيِي أَنَّ التَّعَاوُنَ هُوَ مِفْتَاحُ حَلِّ الأَزْمَةِ.
examples.en: My opinion is that cooperation is the key to resolving the crisis.

examples.ar: لَدَيَّ رَغْبَةٌ شَدِيدَةٌ فِي تَعَلُّمِ لُغَاتٍ جَدِيدَةٍ.
examples.en: I have a strong desire to learn new languages.

examples.ar: أُبَلِّغُكُمْ رِسَالَاتِ رَبِّي وَأَنَا لَكُمْ نَاصِحٌ أَمِينٌ.
examples.en: I convey to you the messages of my Lord, and I am to you a trustworthy adviser.
